features: 📷 360° Panoramic HD Camera – Wide-angle fisheye lens provides full room coverage with clear HD video, eliminating blind spots for complete home monitoring.
🎙️ Two-Way Audio Communication – Built-in microphone and speaker allow real-time listening and talking through the camera for family interaction or visitor alerts.
🌙 Night Vision Support – Infrared LEDs ensure clear video even in complete darkness, providing 24/7 security monitoring.
🚨 Motion Detection Alerts – Smart motion sensing sends instant notifications to your phone when movement is detected.
📱 Remote Live View & App Control – Monitor your home anytime, anywhere using your smartphone via dedicated mobile app (Android & iOS supported).
💡 Easy Bulb Installation (B22) – Simply screw into a standard light socket no wiring or drilling required. Works like a normal bulb with added security.
